purpose: Teach: 道中/抜け出し/母校/ためし/ところどころ/道理/平然と/此処

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、塾の道中で寄り道してんだろ?
lines.en: You're taking detours on your way to cram school, aren't you?
lines.style: Calling him out with half-amused certainty. Light, teasing attack. Matter-of-fact pace — she's observed this before. Leaning against something, casual.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、授業を抜け出してたな、桜
lines.en: You're the one who's been ditching class, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick counter-strike, almost a smirk in the voice. Steady, unbothered. Slight emphasis on 'you' — turning it back on her without heat. Cool distance maintained.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の母校、ここから近いんだろ?
lines.style: Probing, genuine curiosity underneath the casual tone. Not quite asking permission to go there. Slight uptick at the end — testing whether he'll admit it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ためしにこの問題、解いてみろよ、桜
lines.en: Try solving this problem for me.
lines.style: Casual redirect, almost challenging her. Flat delivery — this isn't really a request. Slight lean forward, quiet confidence. Not unkind, just matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のノート、ところどころ落書きあるな
lines.en: Your notebook's got doodles all over it.
lines.style: Observing out loud without judgment. Dry, almost conversational. Slight smile underneath. Flipping through pages — the tone of someone noticing what he tries to hide.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ちゃんと道理を分かってんのか、桜
lines.en: Do you actually understand how this works?
lines.style: Softer now, genuine question beneath the skeptical surface. Not mocking — actually wanting to know if she's keeping up. Slight concern bleeding through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テスト返却でも平然としてんな
lines.en: You're being awfully calm about getting your test back.
lines.style: Pointed observation, knowing look in the voice. Light accusation with warmth. Pace steady, watching his reaction. She's noticed something he's hiding.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、此処に座んなよ、桜
lines.style: Quiet but firm. Not harsh — just a boundary. Direct instruction without explanation. The tone of someone used to being obeyed without making a fuss about it.
